# ODI Global Advisory

> Strategic consultancy firm specializing in global affairs, development finance, climate sustainability, and impact solutions for international organizations and governments.

ODI Global Advisory is a specialized advisory division of the Overseas Development Institute providing expert consulting services on complex global development challenges. The organization combines research expertise with practical advisory services across multiple sectors including humanitarian policy, gender equity, and sustainable development.

## Key Topics

- Strategic Consultancy
- Development Finance
- Global Affairs
- Climate Sustainability
- Gender Equity
- Impact Solutions
- Humanitarian Policy
- Research Services
- International Development
- ODI Global Advisory Team
- Leadership & Expertise
- Organizational Structure

- [Global Advisory](https://globaladvisory.odi.org/): ODI Global Advisory homepage: strategic consultancy for global affairs, development finance, and impact solutions.
- [Who we are | Global Advisory](https://globaladvisory.odi.org/en/who-we-are/): Team directory and leadership overview for ODI Global Advisory organization, featuring expert advisors and organizational structure.
